title: Approval card follow-ups: ork check/fix CLI, note for unreadable checks, fix note in later gate briefs, checks 10+, refused-action wording, duplicate note

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Later notes from the S118 relay (2026-10-26). Owner decisions 2026-10-26: (a) ork approve with [HUMAN CHECK] items is TUI-only for now; add an ork check CLI (and ork fix) so ork approve works from the shell. (b) When human checks cannot be read at approval, approve and write a slicer note that says they could not be read (today: approved with no note). Other notes: (3) the owner fix note is not carried into later gate briefs after a red check or a gate FAIL (internal/engine/states.go, the fix-note path); (4) checks 10 and above cannot be marked in the TUI (digits 1-9 only); (5) a refused owner action shows as 'error:' on the run row (internal/tui/runs.go); (6) a duplicate approval note when the approval update fails after the note was written; (7) UI: align '(new)' files with the diff-stat column, a blank line between card blocks above 24 rows, a wrapped check line at 80x24 can push out the owner recommendation line.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestOrkCheckMarksAHumanCheck; TestOrkFixFilesTheOwnerFix; TestOrkApproveFromTheShellWithChecks; TestApprovalNotesWhenChecksCannotBeRead (approve and write a slicer note that the checks could not be read); TestFixNoteCarriedIntoLaterGateBriefs (after a red check or a gate FAIL); TestChecksTenAndAboveCanBeMarked; TestRefusedOwnerActionShowsNoErrorMarker; TestApprovalNoteNotDuplicatedWhenTheUpdateFails; TestCardAlignsNewFilesWithTheDiffStat; TestCardBlankLineBetweenBlocksAbove24Rows; TestWrappedCheckLineKeepsTheRecommendation at 80x24; goldens.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Re-anchor from the code after S118 and S148 (approval and card code changed). Owner decisions 2026-10-26: add ork check and ork fix CLI so ork approve works from the shell with human checks; when checks cannot be read at approval, approve and write a slicer note saying so. Check marking for 10 and above: type the number (digits accumulate with a short timeout or Enter) or use j/k plus space; pick the simplest that keeps 1-9 as they are and note it. A refused owner action shows the refusal text in the status line, not an 'error:' marker on the run row. UI slice: UI pass (r14). Interview the owner at preflight only if a point above is unclear.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/engine ./internal/cli ./internal/tui; goldens (go test ./internal/tui -update, review the diff); go vet ./...; gofmt -l .; slicer check; adj lint.
